MATCH (a:Drug {id: $drug}), (b:Disease {id: $disease})
MATCH p = (a)-[:TARGET|ENZYME|TRANSPORTER|CARRIER|DISEASE_PROTEIN|PROTEIN_PROTEIN|DRUG_EFFECT|DISEASE_PHENOTYPE_POSITIVE|PHENOTYPE_PHENOTYPE|PHENOTYPE_PROTEIN|DISEASE_DISEASE|PATHWAY_PROTEIN|INDICATION|OFF_LABEL_USE*2..3]-(b)
WHERE all(i IN range(0, length(p) - 1) WHERE NOT nodes(p)[i] IN nodes(p)[i + 1..])
WITH p LIMIT $limit
RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | {key: elementId(n), id: n.id, name: n.name,
                          label: labels(n)[0]}] AS nodes,
       [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS rels

MATCH (n:Drug {id: $id})-[r:TARGET]-(m:Gene)
WHERE type(r) <> 'PREDICTED_INDICATION'
RETURN type(r) AS relation, labels(m)[0] AS label, m.id AS id, m.name AS name
ORDER BY relation, name
LIMIT 50

MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INDICATION]->(dis:Disease) WHERE toLower(dis.name) = 'asthma' RETURN count(DISTINCT d) AS num_drugs
LIMIT 50

MATCH (dr:Drug)-[:INDICATION]->(d1:Disease), (dr)-[:INDICATION]->(d2:Disease) WHERE toLower(d1.name) = 'asthma' AND toLower(d2.name) = 'chronic obstructive pulmonary disease' RETURN DISTINCT dr.name AS drug_name, dr.id AS drug_id LIMIT 50
MATCH (d1:Drug)-[:TARGET]->(g:Gene)<-[:TARGET]-(d2:Drug) WHERE d1.name = 'Ibuprofen' AND d2.name = 'Diclofenac' RETURN DISTINCT g.name AS name, g.id AS id LIMIT 50
MATCH (d:Disease)-[:DISEASE_PROTEIN]-(g:Gene) WHERE toLower(d.name) = 'parkinson disease' RETURN d.id AS disease_id, d.name AS disease_name, count(DISTINCT g) AS gene_count LIMIT 50

MATCH (g:Gene {name: 'PTGS2'})<-[:TARGET]-(d:Drug)-[:INDICATION]->(dis:Disease) RETURN count(DISTINCT dis) AS distinct_disease_count
LIMIT 50

MATCH (dr:Drug)-[:TARGET]->(g:Gene) WHERE g.name = 'PTGS2' MATCH (dr)-[:INDICATION]->(d:Disease) WHERE toLower(d.name) = 'rheumatoid arthritis' RETURN DISTINCT dr.name AS drug_name, dr.id AS drug_id LIMIT 50
MATCH (d:Drug {name: 'Methotrexate'})-[:OFF_LABEL_USE]->(x:Disease) RETURN d.name AS drug_name, d.id AS drug_id, count(DISTINCT x) AS off_label_use_count LIMIT 50

MATCH (d:Drug)-[r:PREDICTED_INDICATION]->(dis:Disease {id: 37784}) WHERE r.ct_studies IS NOT NULL AND r.ct_studies > 0 RETURN d.name AS drug_name, d.id AS drug_id, r.score AS score, r.rank AS rank, r.ct_studies AS ct_studies, r.ct_max_phase AS ct_max_phase ORDER BY r.rank ASC LIMIT 50

MATCH (d:Drug) RETURN count(d) AS drug_count
LIMIT 50
MATCH (d:Drug)-[:INDICATION]->(x:Disease) RETURN d.name AS drug_name, d.id AS drug_id, count(DISTINCT x) AS indication_count ORDER BY indication_count DESC LIMIT 1
